transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... I've been having these episodes with food. Usually it happens at night, maybe after a long shift at the store or if dinner was just really stressful. I'll start eating, and it's like... the part of my brain that makes decisions just completely shuts off. I can literally see myself reaching for more food, but I just can't make myself stop. It's like I completely lose control.
After one of these episodes, do you ever try to get rid of the food or 'make up for it'—for example, by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising intensely?

Yes, I do. Um... usually after everyone goes to bed, I'll go into the bathroom and make myself throw up. Or sometimes I'll take laxatives. I just tell myself it's a way to undo the damage from eating all that food. But honestly, afterward, I just feel really embarrassed... and physically shaky, too.
How often do these episodes of eating and then purging happen—would you say it's about once a week, or more or less frequently than that?

For the last few months, it's been... well, it's been happening most weeks. Usually, I'll have one of those out-of-control nights with food, and then I try to make up for it. I'll make myself throw up, or take those laxatives like I mentioned. Sometimes I'll just skip meals the next day entirely, or force myself to go on a really long walk to try and burn it off. But yeah, I'd say it's about once a week.
You mentioned this has been happening for 'a few months' - can you tell me more precisely how many months this pattern of bingeing and purging has been going on?

It's been... I'd say about six months now. Yeah, right around six months. That's when an older relative of ours came to stay with us, and... well, meals at home just became a lot more stressful for me after they moved in.
Over the past few months, how many binge-and-purge episodes would you say you typically have in a single week?

Like I think I just mentioned a second ago, it's usually about once a week. For the last few months, it's been happening most weeks where I'll have just one of those out-of-control eating nights. And then I try to make up for it, you know, by throwing up, taking the laxatives, skipping meals, or forcing myself to go on a really long walk. But yeah, typically it's just the one episode a week.

latest_inference.note: Confirmed at least weekly binge-purge episodes for 6 months, meeting full frequency and duration criteria for bulimia nervosa; ruling out F50.8 (subthreshold/atypical presentation).

final_diagnosis.reason: Patient reports recurrent episodes of binge eating characterized by subjective loss of control over food intake, followed by regular compensatory behaviors (self-induced vomiting, laxative misuse, fasting, excessive exercise) aimed at preventing weight gain. These episodes have occurred approximately once weekly for about six months, meeting frequency and duration criteria for bulimia nervosa. Associated feelings of shame and physical discomfort (shakiness) further support this diagnosis, with no indication of low body weight or purging-only pattern (which would suggest anorexia binge-purge subtype or purging disorder).
